title: Driver sync commits can be non-building (mid-edit snapshot): f7d28a5b88 E0061
description: Reviewer finding from 831k codereview: the driver's auto 'chore(beads): worker5 sync' commit f7d28a5b88 captured the working tree MID-EDIT and does not build standalone: rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs:611 calls wire_is_for_local_stack with 3 args while stack.rs:811 in that same commit still declares 2 params (E0061), and tests.rs calls advance_rpl_source_route with 3 args against the 4-param signature. HEAD (b76221e930) is consistent; only the intermediate sync commit is broken. Hazard: git bisect across worker-branch history lands on non-building commits. Suggested fix is in the driver/orchestrator, not worker code: either (a) sync-commit only .beads/ paths, or (b) run a compile gate before committing worker-tree snapshots, or (c) snapshot to a temp branch and fast-forward only when clean. Repro: git checkout f7d28a5b88 && cargo check -p lichen-node -> E0061.
